metadata.description: Structured blockchain API skills for AI agents — spec-compliant endpoint routing, workflows, and integration patterns for 100+ chains. Eliminates hallucinated API calls across REST, WebSocket streaming, CLI, and pay-per-request (x402) interfaces.

plugins.name: goldrush-cli
plugins.description: GoldRush CLI - terminal-first blockchain data tool with MCP support for Claude Desktop and Claude Code.

plugins.name: goldrush-foundational-api
plugins.description: GoldRush Foundational API - REST API for historical and near-real-time blockchain data across 100+ chains.

plugins.name: goldrush-hyperliquid
plugins.description: GoldRush Hyperliquid API - the complete data layer for Hyperliquid (HyperCore + HIP-3 + HyperEVM).

plugins.name: goldrush-json-rpc
plugins.description: GoldRush JSON-RPC: multi-chain EVM and Solana JSON-RPC endpoints. An analytics-driven router scores every (provider, chain, endpoint) triple by success rate, latency, error class, and cost, and dispatches each call to whichever upstream is currently winning that route.

plugins.name: goldrush-x402
plugins.description: GoldRush x402 - pay-per-request blockchain data access using the x402 protocol (HTTP 402 Payment Required).
